headline: Perplexity launches its own take on AI agents for work
importance_reason: release · 1 nguồn độc lập · 3 giờ tuổi
summary: Perplexity is taking on OpenAI and Anthropic with its own work-focused AI agents. The startup's new always-on "Teammates" can take on multiple roles within a workspace, while pulling existing projects, skills, and memory from the Perplexity tools you already use. Teammates integrate with Perplexity
